notes.title: EVERING - Update v1.1.0!
notes.notes:
It's been almost 6 months now since we released the full version of EVERING and today we bring you the v1.1.0 update which includes a much requested feature. 

If you have left something unfinished in a previous area, you will now be able to go back in the Flying Thing™ and cross it off your list. We've also added a dedicated button (Keyboard and Gamepad) to directly open the Errands Notebook.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42084367/f87a016c7773262e14537d91ee4bc27459e73340.gif

We have also made some other changes, take a look:


Return to previous areas in the Flying Thing™ (only available in the final stretch of the game). A new NPC awaits you in [spoiler]The Entrails, returning before making the final decision[/spoiler].

Added a quick access to the Errand Book (E on keyboard, Menu/Select on gamepad, you may have to configure yourself for your current save).

Modified some previous zones to make them coherent with the progress of the story.

Fixed numerous minor bugs.

Fixed several translation errors.

New logo screen at the start of the game. Did you know that the game was made by a studio called Purpure Studio? Well, now you know.


There's not a lot in this update but we had to change some systems from the ground up in order to make it work, that's why we consider this one an update and not a patch. From now on you shouldn't expect new updates as we are shifted our focus to a new project, but we'll continue to make patches to fix the issues that may come up. All we can say about our new game right now is that it's not related to EVERING in any way, no DLC, no sequel (maybe in the future, who knows). Follow us on Twitter to stay up to date ;)
 
Remember, you can report to us any issue you found via email, DM on Twitter or on our Discord.

As always, thank you for playing EVERING and for your support and suggestions that make our game better.

Purpure Studio

notes.title: EVERING - Patch v1.0.2 CHANGELOG
notes.notes:
Today we are releasing the second EVERING patch which includes mostly minor corrections and fixes in the English translation:


 Fixed bug that prevented to learn Sanius magic.
 Fixed the bug that prevented to obtain the achievement Make a wish.
 Fixed bugs with a couple of achievements that were unlocked too early.
 Balanced battles against certain enemies.
 Modified the stats of some defense items.
 Fixed several translation errors.
 Fixed other minor bugs.


We'll continue to make these corrections, however small they may be, because we want to make the game as polished as possible.

As we've already communicated on socials, unfortunately EVERING cannot join the Steam Spring Sale because the game was discounted less than 30 days ago, but the game is on sale on Itch until March 21.

Remember, you can report to us any issue you found via email, DM on Twitter or on our Discord.


Have you got all the achievements yet? Get in on it!
Purpure Studio

notes.title: Release date announcement
notes.notes:
That's right, the final chapter of EVERING will be released on February 28, 2024. This also implies the game is leaving Early Access.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42084367/6c94a7176e258a4a483ee53dc3e31e54ecf89954.png

We originally planned to release it at the end of 2023, but it has not been possible to do so in a way that we were satisfied with the final product.

This new chapter, with its new cities and plots, does not come alone. We have been working on a new main menu (which you can see here), a new skill system, a new intro, new cutscenes and side quests, remade scenarios... This final version will also include Steam achievements.

Price change: As with every new chapter, the price will increase to match the game's content. This change will take place on January 28, one month before the launch, in order to offer a discount on release (Steam policy does not allow a discount to be applied until 30 days after a price change). You can take advantage of these next few days to buy EVERING at a reduced price :)

Soon you will be able to enjoy the full EVERING experience!


Thank you!
Purpure Studio.

notes.title: Development Update #2
notes.notes:
Hey, Purpure Studio here! 

We've been a little off for a while, leaving a little aside social media and other interactions, but it's to work hard on the final chapter of EVERING and to be able to release it as soon as possible.

Everything is going well and our plan is to release the final update before the end of the year, we'll give an exact date soon. We're also making major changes to the previous chapters, adding new side quests and other cool stuff.

TL;DR: We are alive and working hard. The final update will be released before the end of 2023!

As always, you can keep up with the news immediately on our Twitter. Here are some images of the last chapter to make the wait shorter :)

notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.notes:
Hey, Purpure Studio here! 

It's been a while since we've communicated with you and we want to let you know that we are still hard at work on EVERING.

Our plan was to release chapter/update 2 of EVERING during the summer but, clearly, it is not going to be possible. We didn't want to give exact dates to avoid having to announce a delay. After all, EVERING is not our main job, we invest our free time in it. This, coupled with real life situations beyond our control, has led to the fact that we have not been able to fulfill our original plan.

In addition to chapter/update 2, we've also been working on the first part. There will be some minor changes and improvements, especially in graphics and music. We've been very concerned about improving the user experience (UX), new tutorials will make the game more intuitive and easier to play. We want to make it more entertaining to get new skills and magics and less tedious side quests.

As promised, the published story will not be affected by new updates or patches, but it is likely that the gameplay will be altered. As a preview, as an example, Lue's spells will level up with uses and she will learn improved versions when the spell reach a certain level.

TL;DR Don't worry! The development of the second part is going well and it will be released soon.

You will have news very very soon, but to keep up to date with news about the game and new locations, we recommend you to follow us on Twitter, because we publish new things every week.


Best regards,

Purpure Studio
